text:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: Pager alert: high KV cache miss rate + continuous-batching regression impacting funcall/structured-output paths. Trigger: 5xx increase and latency cliff on /v1/generate-toolcall - paging oncall. thread_ts=2105006789
Alex G.: acked. I'm oncall, grabbing logs and traces.
Maya R.: adding context — we saw a bump in funcall traffic after customers enabled structured_output=v2 yesterday. Might be correlated.
Sam T.: looking at runtime logs now. early signs: batch fragmentation: many small batches, KV cache eviction spikes.
Alex G.: any immediate mitigation we can do?
Priya K.: can we throttle funcall routes at the edge or disable prefetching for tool calls?
Liam H.: We have a feature flag for structured-output prefetch. Toggle might stop the extra cache churn.
Alex G.: Sam, can you confirm command to toggle?
Sam T.: run from ops console:
```
# disable prefetch for structured tool calls
curl -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN' https://ops.internal/flags -d '{"structured_output_prefetch": false}'
```
Sam T.: also reducing batch window to reduce small-batch fragmentation:
```
# k8s rollout to runtime configmap
kubectl -n runtime set env deploy/inference RUNTIME_BATCH_WINDOW_MS=50
```
Maya R.: heads-up that changing batch window may increase latency slightly but should reduce KV churn.
Alex G.: doing the flag toggle now.
Ops Bot: feature flag structured_output_prefetch set to false by Alex G. :white_check_mark:
Sam T.: applying batch window change to the canary pool now. rolling update started.
Alex G.: I'm rate-limiting the /v1/generate-toolcall endpoint to 30rps/account to buy us breathing room.
Priya K.: adding temporary routing rule to fallback to a simpler model variant for tool calls (no structured output) for affected customers.
Liam H.: Verified metrics: within 2 mins after flag flip, KV cache miss rate down ~60%, small-batch proportion down 45%. Good signal.
Maya R.: error rate for toolcall endpoints dropping from 6.2% -> 1.1% over last 5m.
Sam T.: can we also purge some fugitive KV entries that are hot and fragmented? There's a safe purge script.
Alex G.: Proceed with purge, Sam please run with caution and post command.
Sam T.: running safe purge:
```
python tools/kv_purge.py --pattern="prefetch_*" --rate=1000/s --dryrun=false
```
Sam T.: purge complete. observed further reduction in memory churn.
Alex G.: rolling deploy of the batch-window change to remaining pools. ETA ~6m.
Ops Bot: deployment inference-runtime v2.14.3 started by Sam T.
Liam H.: monitoring traces — tail latency has normalized nearly back to baseline for most regions.
Priya K.: Customer impact: estimated affected requests 12k r/s over 22 minutes, peak error budget burn ~0.5% for top customers. No major customer outages reported but degraded responses for some tool-heavy flows.
Maya R.: contacted CS for top 5 customers and opened a proactive notify.
Alex G.: handing off oncall to Priya K. Summary: structured_output prefetch caused KV churn and batch fragmentation when toolcalls spiked; we toggled prefetch flag, reduced batch window, rate-limited toolcall route, purged prefetch keys, and rolled runtime config. System stabilized.
Priya K.: taking it from here. I'll keep an eye for regressions during the next 2 hours and start postmortem doc.
Liam H.: will capture perf graphs and annotate spikes for the postmortem.
Maya R.: adding follow-ups: 1) safety check on structured_output prefetch for gradual rollout, 2) add circuit breaker for funcall-heavy customers, 3) automated detection for batch fragmentation.
Alex G.: thanks everyone. filing incident ticket and linking postmortem draft: https://confluence.internal/redwood/incidents/IN-2105
Priya K.: set next steps in the doc. will ping for handover if anything pops. :white_check_mark:
